decisions.reason: As a closely related component for the firm's established air-cooler business that appears to have survived the early post-launch selection period, it is likely performing at least near aspiration levels and can be supported by the firm's current growth, R&D capability, and portfolio slack.

Because enhanced heat exchanger tubes fit the firm's core engineering capabilities and can strengthen multiple existing product lines, management would likely judge them as strategically useful and sufficiently promising to retain unless results deteriorate clearly below aspiration.
